title: The module-sheafification scalar square forgets to the identity
statement: For the scalar-presentation square and natural isomorphism rawIso of def-weil-pbc-coefficient-sheafification-iso, forgetting the module structure sends every component of rawIso to the identity of the common abelian sheafification.
